title: Publish Draft Version 21 to production (frontend verification & release checklist)

requirements.summary: Provide a frontend-focused publish checklist and verification steps to ensure production serves the same build/behavior as Draft Version 21, without introducing product/UI changes.
acceptanceCriteria: The production deployment is updated to match Draft Version 21.
Users visiting the production URL see the same behavior/features as in the draft review environment.
No additional code changes are required unless publishing fails due to a detected build/deploy issue (in which case the failure reason is reported).

file_operations.description: Add a concise release/publish checklist for promoting Draft Version 21 to production, including: confirming the draft commit/build identifier, using the existing GitHub export/deploy tooling (use the github-export-icp-cli templates/scripts as the source of deployment workflow—Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing), and a post-deploy verification checklist comparing production vs draft behaviors (routing, auth/login flow, dashboard, leaderboard, chat) to satisfy acceptance criteria without introducing new UI/features.
